Example: 28°N latitude and 77°E longitude locate Delhi.

items: Direct questions often ask for the specific geographic coordinates of major Indian cities like Delhi (28°N, 77°E).
Ensure clarity between North (N) latitude and East (E) longitude designations for Indian geographical positions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Geographical coordinates are expressed using pairs of latitude and longitude.
Delhi is specifically situated at 28°N latitude.
Delhi is specifically situated at 77°E longitude.
